step1_figure.circuit_type: Two-stage CMOS op-amp with cascode diff-amp first stage, class-AB output buffer, and indirect compensation
step1_figure.description: Figure 24.29 shows a high-gain CMOS op-amp consisting of a first-stage cascode diff-amp driving a push-pull/class-AB output buffer (MON/MOP) with indirect compensation via Cc = 240 fF connected to the source of M2T for high PSRR. Its inverting closed-loop step response testbench (R1 = R2 = 10k) is depicted in Fig 24.31 on page 795.

open_loop_dc_gain.description: Low-frequency differential open-loop voltage gain (A_OLDC = A1 * A2)

equation.formula: A_OLDC = A1 * A2 = [gmn * (Rocasn || Rocasp)] * [10 * (gmn + gmp) * (rop || ron) / 10]
equation.explanation: Overall gain is the product of first-stage cascode diff-amp gain A1 (approx. 500) and the second-stage class-AB push-pull buffer gain A2 (approx. 31.6).
equation.assumptions: Unloaded output or high load resistance.

sky130_expected.calculation: For first stage cascode: gm ≈ 150 uA/V, Rocas ≈ 10 to 20 MOhm giving A1 ≈ 300 to 500. Second stage push-pull buffer unloaded gain A2 ≈ 20 to 35 V/V. A_OLDC = A1 * A2 ≈ 8,000 to 16,000 V/V, which is 78 dB to 84 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: In Baker's text the gain is 15,800 (84 dB). On SKY130 with channel lengths L=0.15-0.5 um and higher early voltage effects, 75-85 dB is expected.

equation.formula: fun = A_OLDC * f_3dB ≈ gm1 / (2 * pi * Cc)
equation.explanation: With indirect compensation Cc = 240 fF, the gain-bandwidth product is primarily set by input pair transconductance gm1 and Cc.
equation.assumptions: Dominant single-pole roll-off up to unity-gain frequency.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Consistent with Baker page 793 stating follower bandwidth around 100 MHz.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin of the open-loop amplifier

equation.explanation: Phase of the open-loop gain transfer function at the frequency where |A_OL| = 0 dB.
equation.assumptions: Measured with load capacitance CL = 1 pF.

sky130_expected.calculation: Text states PM is roughly 70 degrees with Cc = 240 fF indirect compensation isolating high-frequency zeros.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Indirect feedback through the cascode transistor source terminal eliminates the RHP zero and boosts PM to ~70°.

dominant_pole_frequency.description: 3-dB corner frequency of the open-loop response

equation.formula: f_3dB = fun / A_OLDC = 1 / (2 * pi * R1 * C_effective)
equation.explanation: High impedance at the cascode diff-amp output node sets the dominant low-frequency pole.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Text gives f_3dB around 10 kHz in Eq. (24.31) and page 794.

equation.explanation: For an inverting amplifier with R1 = R2 = 10 kOhm, feedback factor beta = 0.5, giving bandwidth fun / 2.

sky130_expected.reasoning: With loop gain transmission factor beta = 0.5, bandwidth is approximately half of fun.

slew_rate.description: Large-signal rate of output voltage change

equation.explanation: Limited by diff-pair tail current charging/discharging the compensation capacitor Cc.
equation.assumptions: Diff pair fully steered during step transient.

sky130_expected.calculation: Iss ≈ 20 uA to 40 uA. Cc = 240 fF. SR = Iss / Cc = 20 uA / 240 fF ≈ 83.3 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: With 240 fF compensation capacitor, slew rate is well over 80 V/us.

output_swing_range.description: Peak-to-peak output voltage swing under inverting step excitation

equation.explanation: Class-AB output stage swings close to supply rails: with common-mode 0.9V and 0.8Vpp pulse, output swings symmetrically.
equation.assumptions: Vin pulse from 0.5V to 1.3V (0.8Vpp) centered at VDD/2 = 0.9V.

sky130_expected.calculation: Output swings between ~0.5V and ~1.3V for 0.8V input pulse, with total linear range reaching 0.2V to 1.6V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Step response from 100 mV to 900 mV (800 mV step) corresponds to 0.8 V swing.

quiescent_power.description: Total static DC power consumption including bias circuit and op-amp stages

equation.explanation: Supply voltage multiplied by the total DC current drawn from VDD.
equation.assumptions: Zero input differential voltage, Vin = 0.9V DC.

sky130_expected.calculation: Bias network consumes ~140 uA. First stage consumes ~40 uA. Class-AB output stage consumes ~100 uA. Total current I_VDD ≈ 280 uA. P_DC = 1.8 V * 280 uA ≈ 504 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sum of bias branch currents, diff-pair, cascodes, and push-pull output quiescent currents.

step3_testbench.description: Comprehensive ngspice testbench measuring DC operating point, open-loop frequency response (A_OLDC, f_3dB, fun, PM), closed-loop bandwidth, transient step response, slew rate, output swing, and quiescent power.
